title: Specified finite semi-free filtration of a right dg module
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be an associative unital dg $\mathbf Z$-algebra and $T$ a right dg $A$-module, with right modules, regular module and signed shifts as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category]. For $n\in\mathbf N$, a specified finite semi-free filtration of $T$ consists of right dg modules $F_r$ for $0\le r\le n+1$, degreewise injective dg maps $\iota_r:F_r\to T$, with $F_0=0$ and $\iota_{n+1}$ degreewise surjective, dg maps $s_i:F_i\to F_{i+1}$ with $\iota_{i+1}s_i=\iota_i$ for $0\le i\le n$, and specified quotient modules $L_i$ and degreewise surjections $q_i:F_{i+1}\to L_i$ with $\ker(q_i)=\operatorname{im}(s_i)$. For each $i$, it also specifies a small set $J_i$, integers $k_{ij}$, right dg modules $B_{ij}$ with dg shift comparisons $B_{ij}\cong A[k_{ij}]$ retaining the unchanged right action, and a coproduct cocone $B_{ij}\to L_i$ which identifies $L_i$ with $\bigoplus_{j\in J_i}A[k_{ij}]$. Thus the $F_r$ identify with dg submodules of $T$ and the cocones specify the coordinates of every layer, including the bottom layer. Empty index sets and zero modules are permitted.
